title: Product noise stability on the uniform sign cube
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $[0m\rho\in[0,1]$, and let $f$ be a real-valued function on $[0m\{-1,1\}^n$. Choose $X$ uniformly from the sign cube, and form $Y$ by independently retaining each coordinate of $X$ with probability $(1+ho)/2$ and flipping it otherwise. The expected product $\mathbb{E}[f(X)f(Y)]$ equals the product noise stability obtained by independently retaining each coordinate with probability $[0m\rho$ and otherwise resampling it as a uniform sign.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube
